fixed.summary: A lockstep tick's cost now counts the world's snapshot and hash taken after it, so a rollback peer's maxPrediction budget (the ticks it can re-simulate in half a frame) is no longer over-estimated; dump_room reports it as cost { tickMs, keepMs, rewindMs }.
The per-tick hash reads the snapshot's columns in place instead of decoding every entity: about half the time, the same values.
